name: Accountable
long_description:
Accountable is AI-powered accounting automation for vacation rental property managers. These companies spend money on behalf of hundreds or thousands of property owners on cleaning, maintenance, supplies and repairs. Every dollar has to be paid, tracked, and charged back to the right owner, which most teams still do by hand across disconnected systems.

Accountable handles payments, cards, approvals and expense tracking in one place, and syncs everything to the tools property managers already use: their property management software, field operations tools and accounting system. The result is fewer people doing data entry, accurate owner statements, and books that close 90% faster.

Serving tens of thousands of properties.
one_liner: Smarter Spending for Vacation Property Managers
